children.name: page-products-panel-title
children.content: Develop and Produce Better Parts on the Same Platform

children.name: page-products-p-0
children.content: Carbon’s platform combines the best hardware, software, and service in additive manufacturing to provide a reliable 3D printing process you can depend on.

children.name: page-products-p-1
children.content: All Carbon 3D printers utilize the groundbreaking Carbon Digital Light Synthesis™ (Carbon DLS™) 3D printing process. Additionally, Carbon printers come in a variety of models with build volumes and price points to suit your needs.

children.name: page-products-p-2
children.content: Workhorse 3D printer that scales a wide range of applications from prototyping to mass production. Offering the same high resolution as the M1, the M2 is ideal for smaller parts with intricate features such as threading or internal channels.

children.name: page-products-p-3
children.content: The M3 printer is the cutting edge of DLS printing, ideal for customers looking for faster printing, a simpler print experience, an expanded design space, and a more consistent surface finish.

children.name: page-products-p-4
children.content: The M3 Max printer offers the benefits of next-gen DLS printing with a true 4K light engine, enabling double the build area with the same pixel size and density.
